_doc: MindRoom shell instance: one MindRoom agent with worker-routed shell/file tools behind MindRoom's OpenAI-compatible API (standalone, Docker worker backend), frozen policy gpt-6-luna through the Codex ChatGPT login. Evolve set = 36 terminal tasks in 12 families (3 each), held-out = 12 fresh instances (1 per family); each task is graded by a hidden check in a throwaway network-less container. S = fraction of trials that pass. Search roles run gpt-6-astra through the same Codex login (RRSI_LLM_BACKEND=codex). delta is null so it is calibrated from repeated base evaluations.
